PROVISIONAL_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL. +Karlach, Fury of Avernus +Kindred Discovery +Hammer of Purphoros +Shaun, Father of Synths +Quantum Misalignment +Skorpekh Lord / -Cybermen Squadron -Canoptek Spyder -Adaptive Omnitool -The Master, Multiplied -Anrakyr the Traveller -Etherium Sculptor. 34 lands (unchanged), 9 rocks (unchanged), average nonland MV 3.338, 17 instants/sorceries, 28 creatures. Spellbook unchanged (900-3750 only). Multiplies Cult attack triggers (Karlach second combat, Shaun persistent Synth copies, Quantum two copies, Hammer haste for Cult and every clone) and adds pre-damage Dalek card flow. Losses: the myriad package (Cybermen Squadron + The Master, Multiplied), Spyder's nontoken-ETB draws, Omnitool's artifact dig, Anrakyr's free artifact casting, one of three artifact cost reducers.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (five-swap, staged, not selected). The preferred six without Skorpekh Lord, keeping Etherium Sculptor. Keeps a third two-mana reducer for the 9-rock / expensive-artifact curve; loses team-wide menace and +1/+0 that make Cult, Dalek tokens and Cybermen connect for Sword, Research Thief and Thopter Spy Network. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (four-swap, staged). The preferred six without Karlach and Shaun, keeping Cybermen Squadron and The Master, Multiplied. Myriad copies enter attacking and never trigger Cult (508.4); 13 mana of payoffs for damage only, versus 10 mana that adds Cult attack triggers every turn. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (six-swap, staged). Pass C's Kindred pairing: Kindred Discovery takes Research Thief's slot and Canoptek Spyder stays. The bounded measured test shows Thief is the better draw engine on non-Dalek or fully connecting boards and is a flash flying artifact body; Spyder draws only on nontoken artifact creature entries (15 non-Dalek artifact creature cards in the candidate, none of the tokens). MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (six-swap, staged). Pass C's Karlach pairing: Karlach takes Biotransference's slot and Cybermen Squadron stays. Biotransference makes a 2/2 Necron per artifact spell and turns Shaun, Karlach and the clones into artifacts for Thay, Skorpekh Lord, Research Thief and Master of Etherium; Squadron is a 7-mana damage-only payoff. MODERATE confidence.

REJECT (seven-swap, staged). The preferred six plus Combat Celebrant over Thought Monitor. Celebrant is a third extra-combat source, but it must attack itself, is a nonartifact 3-drop and exerts; Thought Monitor is affinity card draw on an artifact flyer. MODERATE confidence.
